W002-WKO-ACC-005,"Store MAP inheritance, historical override, and immutable snapshot acceptance",W002-WKO-ACC,W002-WKO,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"An acceptance fixture must execute a saved Store-establishing Work Order containing multiple COL alias assignments when no routable Store lineage exists and no structurally malformed Store-MAP-class artifact is present , and prove that exactly one new immutable complete Store MAP is created while the GUI supplies no alias-edit gesture and target artifacts remain unchanged. A later Work Order with the same exact source and no explicit MAP must route to that Store's lineage and inherit its unique newest permitted MAP automatically. Another Work Order must explicitly select an older valid MAP even though newer MAPs for that Store exist and prove that Store/RID binding, alias resolution, and inheritance use exactly the named historical MAP instead. A fixture specifying more than one MAP must refuse. A fixture with two otherwise permitted current MAP candidates for the selected Store sharing the greatest UTC millisecond timestamp must refuse automatic inheritance rather than use UUID as chronology. A separate fixture must remove or corrupt every Store MAP in a prior lineage so that no structurally valid Store MAP remains while at least one malformed Store-MAP-class artifact remains visible in the active Suitcase. Re-running ordinary materialization must refuse before creating a new RID or first Store MAP, and Help must identify the malformed MAP artifact or artifacts. P2-03 Store chronology acceptance: injected-clock fixtures must prove later observed UTC success, equal-millisecond refusal, backward-UTC refusal, and a genuinely future-dated current Store MAP that remains current while blocking successor publication. Every refusal must leave the chronology predecessor unchanged and publish no successor Store MAP. A historical-base fixture must derive requested state from an older eligible MAP while proving that the strict-greater-than comparison uses the actual current Store MAP as chronology predecessor, not the historical base. A deliberate analyst-removal fixture must move the future-dated current MAP out of the active Suitcase and prove deterministic reselection of the remaining structurally valid history; restoring that MAP must make ordinary greatest-UTC authority rules applicable again. Day 060 H-12: every equal/backward/future-predecessor Store-MAP chronology refusal in this acceptance set must emit DS-UTC-001 with exact map_profile: STORE , observed_host_utc , predecessor_map_filename , and predecessor_utc facts.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)

W002-PLAT-001,WASM-002/V1 browser and modest-hardware acceptance baseline,W002-PLAT,W002-PLAT,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"The canonical modest-hardware acceptance machine for the WASM-002 browser release and the browser path carried into V1 is the project's 11-inch Windows 11 laptop with an Intel N100 processor, 16 GB RAM, and a 1920×1200 native display. If the host cannot expose the governed writable-directory contract, Data Sculptor must treat that state as a host-capability refusal , keep governed save/Run/analytical controls locked, and route the explanation through the canonical diagnostic/Help path. W002-UI-ACC-005,Visible-persistence and Suitcase-directory acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"A completed governed browser run must be auditable from the visible Suitcase artifacts required by the build contract, and newly created governed artifacts must become visible through the Suitcase Directory. F-24 session/CER lifecycle acceptance: acceptance must begin from a clean application instance and prove all of the following in one controlled sequence: no Suitcase is selected or silently recovered; Work Order saving and governed Run remain gated; the live browser defaults to Modern Dark and Technical Help; explicitly selecting and successfully validating a writable Suitcase publishes exactly one fresh CER and unlocks the workspace; after switching to Modern Light and a non-Technical Help voice and creating a dirty unsaved WIP, an ordinary reload/navigation path triggers the browser-supported unsaved-change warning where the host permits it; after proceeding with reload, the Suitcase handle, non-default theme, non-default Help voice, and dirty WIP are not restored from Data Sculptor-controlled browser-private persistence; reselecting and successfully validating the same Suitcase publishes a second distinct CER while the first CER remains present under its original governed filename and exact bytes; and no automatic CER-history ZIP, compaction, replacement, or deletion occurs. The acceptance record must inspect the relevant Data Sculptor-controlled browser persistence surfaces and show that no persisted project/session record was used to restore the Suitcase handle, WIP, theme, or Help voice. WASM-002 does not claim dirty-draft warning or recovery after browser crash, forced process termination, operating-system failure, or power loss.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-006,Scope-surface acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"The frozen WASM-002 browser build must not expose executable controls for requirements whose current SCOPE remains V1-BACKLOG, POST-V1, OUT-WASM-002, or otherwise outside the frozen WASM-002 build slice.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-007,"Small-screen, keyboard, and certified-browser acceptance",W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"On the canonical Intel N100 / 16 GB Windows 11 laptop and its 1920×1200 display, acceptance must record the Windows build, display scaling, browser zoom, and exact browser version. In the primary certified Microsoft Edge host, the required browser controls, Work Order editor, governed-stage status, artifact/result surface, and diagnostic/Help surface must remain reachable and usable without requiring an IDE or developer tools, and the required interaction path must be completable by keyboard. Ordinary scrolling and responsive reflow are allowed; changing scaling or zoom merely to expose an otherwise unreachable required control is not. The same canonical machine must also exercise the supported-host Suitcase → CER → Work Order save/Run → governed publication path in the secondary certified Google Chrome host. Chrome must satisfy the same governed filesystem and semantic contract; browser-specific presentation differences do not permit different analytical meaning or a different persistence model.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-008,Persistent diagnostic co-presence acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,Triggering a real governed refusal must leave the Work Order and relevant execution/source context available while the diagnostic is visible in the dedicated Help surface. The refusal must not depend on an application-controlled modal dialog or transient toast as its sole presentation.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-009,Idle-state discipline acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"With no active diagnostic, the dedicated Help surface must remain present but semantically quiet and must not aggregate unrelated project/dashboard state as a substitute for its diagnostic purpose.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-010,Saved-report action acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"From a displayed real diagnostic event, including a governed non-run diagnostic, the user must be able to invoke the Help-report action and obtain the corresponding durable HTML Help Report as one visible governed artifact without manually copying diagnostic text or reconstructing the event. A governed Run fixture containing multiple diagnostic events must also permit one explicit Run-level Help Report request and must produce exactly one HLP for that request. The HLP must identify the included diagnostics in deterministic event order and must not create one HLP automatically for each diagnostic.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-011,Suitcase-first gate and supported-host capability acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"With no Suitcase validated, Work Order saving, governed Run, and analytical processing controls must be unavailable. Acceptance first proves supported-host capability under W002-PLAT-001. Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome acceptance must each expose the required user-selected writable-directory path; Data Sculptor must not satisfy this gate through OPFS, IndexedDB, download-only output, a browser extension, or another substitute persistence model. Acceptance must enumerate every governed final-artifact filename form and SCR staging form that WASM-002 can emit, derive the longest canonical filename length, and verify that the current contract yields 73 ASCII bytes/characters . The canonical __DS__CER__YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSmmmZ__<uuid-v4>.html form is one of the forms at that maximum and is used for the actual create/write/close folder-validation test. After the analyst selects a writable test folder on a supported host, Data Sculptor must create one retained governed certificate whose filename matches that canonical CER form, completely write and close it, and expose it in the visible Suitcase Directory. The certificate must contain the semantic fields and limitation statements required by W002-STOR-022.2. Only after that certificate operation succeeds may the workspace unlock. A failure to create, completely write, or close the certificate after actual folder selection must leave the workspace locked and surface the canonical diagnostic/Help path. Separately, a deterministic missing-capability acceptance fixture must prove that a host lacking the required writable-directory contract refuses before folder validation, leaves the workspace locked, and does not mislabel an untested folder as unwritable. Acceptance must not depend on a hard-coded operating-system path-length number, deletion of the certificate, or a validation-only rename. If the emitted-name inventory changes so that another form exceeds the CER maximum, this acceptance gate must fail until the new maximum is explicitly exercised.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-012,Directory-is-inventory acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"After Suitcase validation, the visible directory must list a mixed fixture set including at least one CSV and one non-CSV file with their physical names, types, and sizes. The directory must expose no “Use as source,” column-pick, or materialize action that bypasses the Work Order.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-013,Generated Work Order identity and immutability acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,Saving a valid draft must create a new TXT artifact whose physical name matches the frozen Work Order filename contract and must not open a filename-entry Save As path. Editing the draft and saving again must create a different Work Order identity; the first saved TXT bytes and filename must remain unchanged.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-014,Work-Order-only source and column selection acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"Using a Suitcase containing multiple candidate files and a CSV with multiple headers, the analyst must be able to request the source and materialized column solely through a saved Work Order. Acceptance must show that the browser performs no separate point-and-click source or column selection. F-26 SOURCE eligibility fixtures: the acceptance set must prove all of the following under W002-WKO-009.1: analyst-owned root files ending .csv , .CSV , and a mixed-case equivalent are recognized as CSV candidates; the complete physical filename reference remains exact and case-sensitive under F-15; an analyst-created __DS__notes.csv is refused as an analyst-owned SOURCE; a valid published CVT is accepted; a canonical-looking or renamed file that does not satisfy the governed CVT validity/publication contract is refused; governed non-CVT classes including COL are refused as SOURCE; a non-CSV analyst-owned extension is refused even if its bytes are CSV-like; and path, traversal, subdirectory, URL/URI, and external-file references are refused.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-015,Read-only Execution Output acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"The execution surface must display the selected saved Work Order, source resolution, relevant stage/refusal facts, and resulting artifact identity while accepting no command input. Keyboard focus in the execution surface must not create a second execution path.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-016,Store-MAP snapshot persistence and read-only directory acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"Creating or changing governed alias/Store metadata through a saved Work Order must create one new immutable complete Store MAP in the same flat Suitcase while preserving earlier MAPs and leaving target artifact bytes and physical filenames unchanged. After a governed run that creates a new Store MAP, refreshing/reopening the Suitcase may display Store, RID, and COL aliases from the exact Store lineage and Store MAP resolved for that specific governed operation. The directory must not infer a global “current Store,” guess from unrelated newest MAP timestamps, or independently choose or mutate Store/MAP authority for execution.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-017,"Store-aware MAP selection, historical override, and anti-rebinding acceptance",W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"A saved materializing Work Order that does not explicitly name a MAP must use exact SOURCE matching against the one common source_filename carried by each routable Store lineage's Store MAP. A routable Store lineage is one with at least one structurally valid Store MAP, regardless of later Store-health state. A fixture with exactly one routable Store lineage must route to that lineage and, when its health permits materialization, inherit the Store's unique newest permitted MAP and record both the MAP identity and bound rid_filename in execution evidence. A fixture with no routable Store lineage and no structurally malformed Store-MAP-class artifact present may establish a new Store. A fixture with more than one routable Store lineage for the same source must refuse automatic selection. An explicit-MAP fixture must prove that SOURCE must exactly equal the selected MAP's common source_filename . A different source must refuse before materialization even when source/RID row counts happen to match. A separate all-MAPs-damaged fixture must leave one or more structurally malformed Store-MAP-class artifacts visible while no routable lineage can be established. The UI/run path must refuse before new-Store/RID creation and expose Help that identifies the malformed MAP artifact or artifacts; it must not present the condition as an unseen source. Another fixture must prove that explicitly naming an older valid MAP overrides the newer default for that same Store. More than one explicitly named MAP must refuse. An equal-greatest-timestamp ambiguity within the selected Store lineage must refuse automatic selection. Once an inherited Store MAP has been selected for a run, creation of a newer MAP during execution must not silently rebind that in-progress run. P2-03 authority/clock acceptance: the UI/evidence path must distinguish the selected operation base MAP from the chronology predecessor used for successor UTC validation. When a future-dated current MAP blocks publication, the UI must not label that MAP corrupt merely because of its timestamp, must identify it as the blocking current authority, and must route to Help describing the clock correction/wait/deliberate-removal choices without performing any automatic fallback or filesystem move.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-018,Help-Engine-only messaging acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"For representative Suitcase validation, Work Order validation, source-resolution, and analytical refusal cases, user-facing guidance must be traceable to the Help Engine/canonical diagnostic path. Acceptance must show no competing ad hoc semantic refusal text generated independently by individual analytical controls.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-019,No standalone Work Order Description acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"Acceptance must prove the architecture that WASM-002 permits: the browser exposes no standalone editable Work Order Description field; no separate mutable or hidden Work Order-description store exists; editing any governed WKO byte transitions a loaded saved WKO into a derived draft; the predecessor WKO TXT bytes, physical filename, and UUID remain unchanged; and the derived draft cannot Run until saved as a new WKO identity.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-020,Theme semantic-invariance acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"The same saved Work Order and governed diagnostic fixture must be exercised under Modern Dark and Modern Light. Acceptance evidence must show identical Work Order resolution, diagnostic ID and structured facts, continue/refuse decision, and analytical result/provenance across both themes, with only governed live-browser presentation differences. The browser must expose no Custom or Terminal governed theme choice in WASM-002. Acceptance must also verify that switching between Modern Dark and Modern Light does not change the canonical built-in presentation of a generated HLP or CER.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-UI-ACC-021,Flight Recorder read-only derivation acceptance,W002-UI-ACC,W002-UI,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"Acceptance must populate the Suitcase with governed RCP artifacts for at least one successful Run and one refused Run whose Receipt publication succeeded, then reconstruct the Flight Recorder surface solely from those Receipts. The rendered history must preserve each Receipt's governed execution outcome and lineage while allowing only read-only presentation operations. A separate fixture must represent a Run for which Receipt publication failed under W002-RCP-010 and prove that the Flight Recorder does not invent, backfill, or reconstruct a canonical Receipt from transient execution state. User interaction with the Flight Recorder must not modify, delete, rename, rewrite, supersede, or create RCP artifacts and must not create hidden persistent history state.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-001,Certification interprets nothing analytically,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,The certification stage establishes source-encoding validity and evidence; it does not perform analytical materialization.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-002,Materialization assumes nothing about encoding,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,Materialization proceeds only under the governed UTF-8-certified-source invariant and does not guess or silently change source encoding.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-003,Conversion is a separate transformation,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"Windows-1252-to-UTF-8 conversion is an explicit user-authorized operation producing a new artifact, not a hidden fallback.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-004,The fast path preserves strictness,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"ASCII-first acceleration is an optimization of strict UTF-8 certification, not a relaxation of validity rules. W002-ARCH-005,Help is first-class,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,The shared engine emits governed diagnostic truth; the Help Engine owns governed explanation.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-006,PRETTY is first-class,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,The PRETTY Engine owns deterministic human-facing rendering.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-008,One shared semantic core,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,The WASM-first implementation must remain suitable for later use by a standalone native CLI host without creating a permanent second semantic engine.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-011,Open source and commercial service are separate layers,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,The open-source analytical product and Red5Sorcery's optional paid automation must remain architecturally distinguishable. A paid service may save work; it must not become a hidden prerequisite for executing or understanding the delivered analytical software.,NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-014,WASM-002 and V1 analytical execution are sequential,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"WASM-002 must execute governed analytical operations sequentially and predictably. The product must not expose worker-count, thread-count, task-parallelism, or similar tuning controls, and it must not silently introduce a parallel analytical execution mode whose ordering or resource use changes the governed semantics. Sequential execution does not require inefficient repeated scans. One bounded structural source pass may process multiple requested columns together, and implementation may use ordinary low-level/runtime mechanisms that do not create user-visible analytical concurrency or change deterministic operation order. Any future analytical parallelism requires a separate measured experiment and explicit PRD decision.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
W002-ARCH-014.1,WASM-002 has a single-writer Suitcase contract,W002-ARCH,W002-ARCH,WASM-002,UNDER REVIEW,—,"WASM-002 assumes one user, one active Suitcase, and one Data Sculptor writing execution context at a time . Multiple read-only views may observe the same Suitcase, but concurrent governed writers—including a second browser tab or window attempting governed writes against the same Suitcase—are outside the supported WASM-002 contract. WASM-002 does not implement cross-tab locks, filesystem leases, lockfiles, hidden coordination state, or multi-writer merge/rebase semantics. This is an explicit product boundary, not an implicit guarantee that concurrent writers are safe. Before a governed transaction reaches its authoritative commit point, Data Sculptor must re-resolve and revalidate the governing state on which the transaction depends. If relevant governed state has changed since the transaction established its basis, publication must refuse rather than overwrite the newer authority, silently rebase itself, synthesize another chronology, or report success. Candidates already created remain subject to the existing rollback and attributable SCR recovery-evidence rules. Help must explain the boundary in ordinary terms: do not run two writing Data Sculptor contexts against the same Suitcase at the same time. If a pre-commit guard detects changed authority, the safe next action is to refresh or reopen the current governed state and rerun deliberately. Acceptance evidence must inject a relevant Store-MAP and WKO-MAP authority change after transaction preparation but before commit and prove that the newer authority remains authoritative and the stale transaction refuses.",NOT_STARTED,NOT_TESTED,NOT_REVIEWED,NOT_ACCEPTED,,,,,,,Revision BM Day 060 H-31 (frozen WASM-002 scope)
